issues.explanation: Tampered mode string causes unhandled ValueError (500) instead of validation error or safe fallback like waitingTickets uses.
Read-only helpers are public Livewire endpoints instead of protected, exposing callableQueries/selectedQueue/waitingTickets/viewingQueue to direct client calls.
grantAccess, revokeAccess and callNext rely only on domain-action authorization with no $this->authorize in the component, missing defense-in-depth.
User-input properties name, renameName, mode and selectedQueueId have no #[Validate] attributes and actions never call $this->validate, diverging from the #[Validate] project pattern.
Rate limiting of successful serve calls (10/min, abort 429) is implemented but has no test covering hit or tooManyAttempts.

conventions.evidence: Uses CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket, scoped $entity->queues()->findOrFail, Bulma boxes, <x-label>/<x-input>, CHANGELOG + business-rules sync; but no #[Validate] on name:76/renameName:94/mode:334 and helpers callableQueues:354/waitingTickets:381/viewingQueue:271 are public not protected

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:146 openQueue/closeQueue, app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:402 callNext; small focused methods, clear names, sibling Bulma style, no dead code

requirements.evidence: Queues list button class="button is-fullwidth p-3 mb-2" wire:click="openQueue" queues.blade.php:652, create slug Str::slug Queues.php:129, rename slug re-derived Queues.php:198, toggle modal queues_toggle_title queues.blade.php:753, accessQueue null-safe Queues.php:282, serve waiting order/limit Serve.php:391-399, tabs role="tablist" members.blade.php:598; edge gap CallMode::from($this->mode) Serve.php:419 throws on tampered mode

scope.evidence: All hunks serve task (Queues.php, Serve.php, blades, routes entity.queues/entity.serve, lang keys, members tabs, navbar); docs CHANGELOG/business-rules only; no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: Scoped findOrFail Queues.php:148,173,191,230,257 + authorize create/update/manageAccess, serve findOrFail Serve.php:416, #[Locked] entity/lastCalledTicketId, {{ }} escaping, tamper-safe accessQueue find Serve.php:282; gaps: no explicit authorize in grant/revoke/callNext, public helpers, unvalidated mode ValueError

simplicity.evidence: Reuses domain actions and policies, no service layers, Eloquent reads in render, minimal extra lang keys only for UI labels

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesUiTest.php:255 + ServeUiTest.php:189 cover list, create duplicate slug, rename collision, toggle modal, grant/revoke audit, tampered accessQueueId, foreign queue 404, unauthorized employee/non-member, locked lastCalledTicketId; missing rate-limit test

review.summary: Adds Queues and Serve Livewire panels, members tabs, navbar links, routes and locales with scoped resolution and domain-action writes plus extensive Pest tests. No exploitable flaw found; overall 4 approve with nits for unvalidated mode ValueError, public helpers, missing #[Validate] and untested rate limit.
